one_line: YouTube/Web transcript-first source collector that summarizes, analyzes, and converts dialogue/script material into VectorFL space-learning and maturation packets.
notebooklm_similarity: source-grounded summary/organization/analysis over original transcript sources
vectorfl_difference: primary output is not just answer/summary but bias-countering multi-layer space-maturation evidence with source deltas and Codex-readable matching packets
core_intent: increase diversity of layers and interpretations in VectorFL space
avoid one-sided space bias by intentionally sampling sources across claims, tensions, actors, contexts, and counter-frames
preserve original source and timestamp grounding
produce learning cards that can later be matched against existing VectorFL space maps

actors.Hermes: search/fetch/normalize/analyze/organize/write HOLD packets; preserve original and changed_judgment
actors.Codex: later read-only space-map matching and maturation proposal from Hermes packets; not called by default
actors.Gemini: optional Codex-side wide/layer lens when Codex judges layer ambiguity; not Hermes-direct default

mvp_pipeline.notes: state why this source batch counters or enriches space bias
no video download; transcript availability is a hard gate
sha256, language, duration, segment_count, url, fetched_at
chapters, key claims, concepts, quotes, open questions
claims, assumptions, tensions, LACL candidates, layer shifts, operator-load/context-cost
detect one-sided corpus, missing counter-frames, domain skew, authority over-weight

bias_countering_rules: Do not collect only agreement sources; require contrastive or orthogonal sources per batch when possible.
Separate speaker claims from Hermes interpretation.
Preserve rejected refs and why they did not change judgment.
Do not treat popular/high-view videos as authority.
Use timestamps for every strong claim when available.
mvp_non_goals: web app UI before pipeline proof
